fee_notes: Single unit: $40,000 initial franchise fee + $10,000 Development Services Fee. Development Rights Agreement: $50,000 total (includes $30,000 credit toward first unit fee). Additional units under DRA add $10,000 each credited toward $30,000 fee per unit.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee due under each Franchise Agreement (where no development rights are granted) is a lump sum payment of $40,000, payable in full when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
